answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the garden queue while honest participants promoted earlier continues earning. The river index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 673 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the echo. Slashing removes 29 percent at once. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
